name: AI Multi-Agent Web Research System
description: A system of three AI agents that work together to search the web. A coordinator agent receives the user query, a researcher agent uses MCP Firecrawl to gather information, and a summarizer agent compiles the results.

name: AI RAG Agent with MongoDB
description: A retrieval augmented generation agent that uses MongoDB as a database and Google GenAI to convert text to vectors. It uses vector index search and a custom tool to transform user queries for comparison.

name: Washington State EV Adoption Dashboard
description: An interactive data storytelling dashboard exploring 280,000+ electric vehicle registrations in Washington State. Features four interconnected visualizations with unified filters covering adoption trends, market share, range evolution, and geographic concentration.

name: Personal Portfolio with Auto-Update Skill
description: A React-based portfolio site deployed on GitHub Pages, featuring an automated Claude Code skill that updates the About Me, Projects, and Resume sections every time a new project is launched — eliminating the need to manually edit three separate files per project.

name: Hadoop WordCount - Big Data Analysis
description: Deployed a multi-node Apache Hadoop cluster (1 Master, 3 Slaves) on AWS EC2 to perform MapReduce WordCount analysis on Project Gutenberg literary works. Custom Java Mapper/Reducer processes large-scale unstructured text through HDFS and YARN, revealing Power Law word frequency distributions across classic literature.

name: Claude Code Skills Collection
description: Three custom Claude Code skills I built for daily use: a fitness coach that generates personalized weekly diet plans with verified grocery prices, a conversational video editor with frame-accurate cuts and motion graphics, and a project launch pipeline that ships repos, updates my portfolio, and posts to social media — all from one command.

name: Stock Price Prediction - Improved Transformer
description: A deep learning capstone project predicting next-day stock prices using an improved transformer model with wavelet denoising, adaptive time windows, and convolution-enhanced self-attention. Achieved a 55.8% trade win rate and 17%+ annualized simulated profit on Verizon (VZ) stock over 252 test days. Includes FinBERT sentiment analysis pipeline and LSTM baselines.
